sources.entry: YANA - Turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island for media, volume and brightness HUDs, notifications, Messages, iPhone calls, calendar, weather, timers, and a file shelf. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/veaceslavmafteiaevoluta/yana) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: YANA is a free, open-source macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island-style area for media controls, HUDs, notifications, messages, calls, calendar, weather, timers and a file shelf.
summary.what_it_does: YANA draws a black window shaped like the notch above the menu bar and shows live activity on its sides, such as album art with an equalizer or a timer countdown. It has Now Playing controls for Spotify and Apple Music, and media-key control for other apps. It replaces the system volume and brightness overlays, showing charging and low-battery alerts, and offers audio output switching and per-app volume for Spotify and Music. The notch also shows grouped app notifications, SMS/iMessage previews with quick reply, iPhone call history and keypad, upcoming calendar events with one-click join for Zoom, Meet, Teams and Webex, and current weather with an hourly forecast from Open-Meteo. Other modules include Pomodoro and custom timers, a file shelf for dropping and later dragging files out, CPU/RAM/battery rings, and quick system actions. Gestures for opening, closing and switching tabs are supported.
use_cases: replace the macOS volume and brightness overlay
control Spotify or Apple Music from the notch
see and reply to iMessage texts on Mac
join calendar meetings from the menu bar
hold files temporarily and drag them out later
run Pomodoro timers visible in the notch
check weather without opening an app
how_to_run: Download YANA-x.y.z.dmg (or .zip) from the latest release and drag YANA to Applications.
Open YANA from Applications; if blocked, allow it under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway (or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/YANA.app).
Grant Accessibility and Full Disk Access manually in System Settings > Privacy & Security, then quit and reopen YANA.
Build from source: xcode-select --install, git clone the repo, cd yana.
Run ./build.sh to create build/YANA.app, then cp -R build/YANA.app /Applications/ and open it.
stack: Spotify and Music via macOS automation
notable: Free and open source under MIT, with English and Italian localization
Reads Messages, call history and notification databases read-only; no analytics or telemetry, per README
Builds with only Command Line Tools, no Xcode required
Gesture support: swipe down to open, swipe up to close, swipe sideways to switch tabs or skip tracks
Notch-less Macs get a virtual notch in the menu bar
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later and Apple Silicon; not notarized, so Gatekeeper must be bypassed on first launch
Needs manual Accessibility and Full Disk Access grants, and without them several modules stay empty or disabled
Since macOS 15.4 full track info works only for Spotify and Music; other apps get media-key control only
Incoming iPhone calls cannot be answered from the notch, and the equalizer is animation rather than real audio analysis
